desc:
Build your dream skyscraper city apartment in a beautiful glass penthouse! 🏙️

In Build Your Apartment, your apartment is up to you.
🛋️ Choose from 100+ items and furniture to create your apartment
💾 Save and load your apartments, building up your collection
🔧 Allow your friends to build your apartment with you
🕹️ Use the wiring system to make working mechanisms

Build Your Apartment is a free-to-build sandbox game, meaning you can place an unlimited amount of blocks, furniture and items without needing to pay for each one. Build whatever you want in your apartment, the only limit is your creativity; whether it be a pool apartment, tropical apartment or modern apartment. 🏙️

Build Your Apartment is in Beta, meaning new items and updates are constantly being added.
💖 We appreciate your support during this time.

#BuildYourApartment
